title: A governed ClickHouse MCP server: agents query the semantic layer, not the database
outcome: Give Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client ClickHouse analytics through four governed tools: only published datasets, no SQL, one tenant per server.

env.name: TENANT_ID
env.description: The tenant this server process may see (seed tenants: 153, 170, 146). Set by the MCP client's launch config, never by the agent.

env.name: HYPEQUERY_MCP_INCLUDE_SQL
env.description: Set to 1 to include generated SQL in tool results, for a trusted debugging session only

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD
env.description: ClickHouse password (default: hypequery, the seed's password)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE
env.description: Database holding the seed tables (default hypequery_examples)
